sections.label: VWO court order scheme
sections.summary: A VWO can apply for a Court Order to manage a fixed sum for a senior's daily care needs, supervised by OPG.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Under the scheme, the VWO can apply for a Court Order to manage a fixed sum of money to meet a senior’s daily care needs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Once appointed by the Court, the VWO will be supervised by the Office of the Public Guardian (OPG) and required to submit periodic reports.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: OPG will check that the seniors’ monies are used prudently and only for the purposes of meeting their care needs, in accordance with the terms set out in the Court Order.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: If there is indication that anyone has acted in any way which compromises the person's best interest, including exploiting the person financially, the Public Guardian will investigate and take appropriate action.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Where necessary, the Public Guardian may apply to Court to protect the personal or financial welfare of the person and refer the case to the Police for further investigation if any criminal conduct is suspected.
